title: Where every film director is from
excerpt: I mapped the birthplaces of 43,619 film directors in Wikidata: New York and Paris lead, Prague and Copenhagen lead per head, Asia's share has grown since the 1950s, one in seven made their films abroad, and women went from 3% of new directors in the 1920s to 32% in the 2020s.
seo_description: A map of where film directors were born: top cities and countries, the shift towards Asia, directors who worked abroad and the rise of women.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where every film director is from' in black, red and amber on cream, beside a world map of hexagons shaded from pale yellow to dark red by the number of film directors born there, darkest in Europe, the eastern United States and India. Text: the birthplaces of 43,619 film directors in Wikidata, from the silent era to the 2020s.
